Reminiscing road to Liberation in 1971 held at IGCC
2021-12-05T20:28:30+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/diplomacy/news/reminiscing-road-liberation-1971-held-igcc-2910321

In recognition of the Maitree Diwas, both Bangladesh and Indian governments each year commemorate the invaluable contribution of valiant Muktijuddhas in the journey towards the Liberation of Bangladesh.

As part of the celebration, a "Maitree Week" was celebrated from November 30 to December 5, according to a press release from the High Commission of India in Dhaka today.

As part of the celebrations, an event reminiscing about the road to Liberation in 1971 and events leading to Victory Day was organised at the Indira Gandhi Cultural Centre.

Valiant Muktijuddhas shared their invaluable experiences of Bangladesh's Liberation War at the event and recounted important events that culminated in Victory Day, added the release.
